origin: Built by Muse (AI assistant) on 17 November 2026 at Steven Powell's request for an online-radio room, 'The Radio Room': a retro wooden-cabinet CSS radio playing verified live SomaFM streams, a verified 18-link listening shelf in six groups (music services, live stations incl. Audacy formerly Radio.com, public radio, Broadcastify/OpenMHz scanners, WebSDR/KiwiSDR, old-time radio archive), a plain-language workshop (station stream vs personalized service vs scanner feed, scanner delays, WebSDR), a Help menu with full documentation, and reciprocal links with Tonight's Sky and A Library. No upstream original exists; the collection copy is the maintained original.
